applicabilityBasis.summary: JupUSD is marketed as a USD-referenced reserve-backed settlement stablecoin on Solana. Issuer documentation provides 1:1 issuance and direct redemption for USDC/USDtb collateral, subject to whitelisting and a 0.04% fee. The structure appears payment-stablecoin-like; the published technical redemption mechanism does not independently establish all statutory holder rights. Jupiter interface terms prohibit U.S. wallets, an access restriction that does not establish a GENIUS exemption.

genius.notes: The reviewed materials identify Jupiter and Ethena operational roles but do not name the legal JupUSD issuance obligor. Block Raccoon S.A. is named only as Jupiter interface provider; no issuer domicile or formal pathway is assigned from that interface role. Anchorage/Ethena USDtb partnership concerns a reserve asset and establishes no JupUSD permission. The official live holdings API publishes supply and collateral balances for the mint in the base record; these data are self-published, not an independent monthly attestation. The transparency landing page did not expose holdings in the independently opened browser view, so the working official API is linked as the reserve disclosure. Published collateral-redemption mechanics do not establish an unrestricted right for retail holders to receive fiat at par. No matching public enforcement action was located in the bounded regulator-domain search. Section 20 sets the Act's effective date to January 18, 2027 or 120 days after implementing final regulations, whichever is earlier; no earlier-triggering final rules were located in the reviewed materials. The distinct general DASP offer/sale gate in section 3(b)(1) starts July 18, 2028. No current GENIUS offer/sale prohibition is asserted.

September 30, 2026 SCRC procedural rule: no issuer-specific state qualification established by this rule.
NYDFS public regulated-entities table and Greenlist: no JupUSD / Jupiter / Block Raccoon S.A. named authorization identified; absence is limited to these published lists.

Current JupUSD user and developer documentation, Jupiter interface Terms of Use, live holdings API and Anchorage/Ethena USDtb announcement reopened: no JupUSD-specific approval, filed application or formal route disclosed.

Domain-restricted searches of OCC, FDIC, Federal Reserve, NCUA, NYDFS and Treasury for JupUSD / Jupiter / Block Raccoon S.A. plus GENIUS/approval/application, including enforcement terms: no matching issuer-specific public result found.
negativeEvidenceReview.summary: No token-specific PPSI approval, state qualification, official GENIUS application or registered foreign exception was located for JupUSD / Jupiter / Block Raccoon S.A. in the opened sources and bounded name searches. Published proposals and bank/money-transmitter licenses do not establish GENIUS permission. This review is limited to public materials and does not establish that an authorization or nonpublic application cannot exist.
